findings.excerpt: Assume AC. For m≥2 and 1≤i≤2m−2, π_i(S^m)⊗Q is Q if i=m and zero otherwise. Hurewicz after tensoring with Q is an isomorphism in all these degrees; in degree m its integral version is the standard orientation-generator isomorphism; no finiteness of the torsion groups is asserted.
findings.symptom: The homotopy and rational coefficient formulas appear as plain ASCII-style notation (including π_i and S^m) instead of typeset mathematics.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the mathematical expressions in supported math delimiters so the statement formulas render as mathematics.

findings.excerpt: The locally rederived rational cohomology calculation in the rational $K(\mathbb Z,n)$ calculation gives H^a(K(Z,m);Q)=0 for 0<a<2m, a≠m.
findings.symptom: The proof mixes rendered inline math with plain formula strings such as H^a(K(Z,m);Q)=0 and 0<a<2m, leaving the formula syntax visibly untypeset.
findings.suggested_repair: Put the formula strings in supported math delimiters and use consistent mathematical notation throughout the proof paragraph.

findings.excerpt: Assume the displayed identification M=F₂[w₁,w₂,…]U and the formulas of [[def-whitney-sum-coalgebra-on-stable-unoriented-thom-cohomology]].

findings.symptom: Displayed coproduct formulas in the proof are plain text with literal indices and operators; the same untypeset notation continues in the rank-transition formulas and the next proof step.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the coproduct formulas and indexed expressions in supported math delimiters, and format the displayed stabilization square as mathematics.

findings.excerpt: Assume AC. For the detector f_r:T_r→P_r, the pullback f_r*:H̃ᵏ(P_r;F₂)→H̃ᵏ(T_r;F₂) is an isomorphism for every k<2r. No comparison is asserted at k=2r.
findings.symptom: The main map and cohomology groups are displayed as baseline formula notation (for example f_r and H̃ᵏ) instead of typeset mathematics.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the detector and cohomology expressions in supported math delimiters.

findings.excerpt: For k<r, the Thom-cell description gives H̃^k(T_r)=0. Every factor K(F₂,r+d_b) is (r−1)-connected, so the finite product has zero reduced cohomology in degrees below r.
findings.symptom: Proof formulas and indexed cohomology expressions throughout steps 1.1–5.1 are rendered as plain text, including H̃^k(T_r)=0 and K(F₂,r+d_b), with no mathematical typesetting.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap all proof formulas in supported math delimiters and use consistent mathematical notation for indexed spaces and cohomology groups.
